subject: [AMBER] EAMD_BOOST and reweighting of AMD runs

messages.author: Rosellen, Martin
messages.body:
Dear all,
I am trying to do the reweighting of my AMD runs like in
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/advanced/tutorial22/section3.htm
Unfortunately, the script  awk 'NR%1==0' amd.log | awk '{print ($8+$7)/(0.001987*300)" " $2 " " ($8+$7)}' > weights.dat
produces a weights.dat in a wrong format in the case of AMBER18. I wanted to adjust this script but there is no mentioning in the AMBER18 manual of what unit the field EAMD_BOOST in the amd.log file has.
best
Martin
